selection_rule: match copy by season, scene, environment, temperature, expression, action, props and product context; reject mismatch; regenerate only if no approved candidate matches
product_rule: product-specific copy uses approved formal DM/products-v3 first; ZIP post art must never redefine product package identity
review_rule: any selected, regenerated or edited media returns to pending_review and must pass all 16 review items before scheduling or publishing
